# Material Design Icons

Toothbrush icon by Michael Irigoyen, from Pictogrammers Material Design Icons.

- Icon: https://pictogrammers.com/library/mdi/icon/toothbrush/
- Original vector: https://github.com/Templarian/MaterialDesign/blob/master/svg/toothbrush.svg
- License: Apache License 2.0. Its text ships in the app and is stored once, in `app/src/main/assets/licenses/apache-2.0.txt`; `components.json` beside it lists this icon for the About page.

The original vector path is reproduced as a Compose ImageVector. Colors come from Momentum’s shared Care presentation.
